question: To which principle is obeisance offered as the yoga-lotus-seat of universal union?
premises: The addressed principle is described as the self of the yoga-lotus-seat.
This seat is characterized by union with all selves.
inference: Obeisance is offered to the self of the yoga-lotus-seat of union with all selves.
uncertainties: The internal structure of the long compound allows multiple close readings.
plain_english: Obeisance to the self of the yoga-lotus-seat of union with all selves.
